newsitem.title: NORWAY: Gullfaks, Tordis halting output for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Gullfaks, Tordis halting output for maintenance.

text.p: The North Sea Gullfaks development is stopping production for annual turnaround which also affects the nearby Tordis platform, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Friday.
Statoil's Gullfaks maintenance takes out about 500,000 barrels per day (bpd) from Norwegian production, including 75,000 bpd from Saga Petroleum's Tordis field.
"Gullfaks B stopped production yesterday," a Statoil spokesman said. "Tordis stopped early this morning. Gullfaks A and C are halting production tonight."
He said the Gullfaks platforms would resume output on October 24-25 while Tordis' maintenance would last until October 28.
The turnaround was delayed from the original date of August 16 because of an eight-week strike by electricians.
